name: Ron Zacapa Solera Gran Reserva Rum
flavour_style: caramel, vanilla, cocoa, dried fruit, honeyed sweetness, spices, molasses, smoke
description: A benchmark rum for many, Ron Zacapa is made from the first press of sugar cane and aged high in the Guatemalan mountains, where it benefits from cooler temperatures that slow maturation and deepen its character. Using the solera method, it combines spirits aged between six and 23 years to create consistent flavour. Expect aromas of caramel, vanilla, cocoa and dried fruit, followed by a palate of honeyed sweetness, spices and a long, velvety finish with hints of molasses and smoke.

name: The Scarlet Ibis 18 Year Old Rum The Whisky Exchange
flavour_style: lush, fruity rum with a heady nose. Sweet ripe banana, dark sugar, chocolate and soft spicing
description: The first ever rum bottled by The Whisky Exchange, this is an exquisite molasses-based distillate made and aged in Trinidad for something very special. 18 years maturing in the island’s tropical climate have resulted in a lush, fruity rum with a heady nose. Sweet ripe banana, dark sugar, chocolate and soft spicing all combine for a rum to remember.

name: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
flavour_style: rich, sticky rum infused with vanilla, caramel and an assortment of baking spices
description: Introduced to the UK in Spring 2010, Kraken is a dark spiced Caribbean rum that quickly gained popularity thanks to its vintage-style bottle and outstanding packaging. Inside, you'll find a rich, sticky rum infused with vanilla, caramel and an assortment of baking spices. Perfect for mixing into a Cuba Libre.

name: Foursquare Hereditas 14 Year Old Exclusive to The Whisky Exchange
flavour_style: fruity, rich
description: Hereditas is a fruity, rich 14-year-old rum from Foursquare distillery in Barbados, bottled exclusively for The Whisky Exchange. Matured in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, this is a bold tropical rum with notes of raisins, banoffee and stewed berries throughout the palate.

name: Isla N White Rum
flavour_style: sweet, spicy
description: A sweet, spicy single estate white rum made using fermented sugar cane from Tucuman in Argentina. The nose is sweet and smooth, with notes of vanilla, coconut, caramel and milk chocolate, building into richer coffee aromas. The palate opens with lighter notes of vanilla and caramel, before deepening with notes of spiced oak, peanut butter and toffee.

name: Stroh '80' Austrian Rum
flavour_style: rich notes of caramel burnt sugar and spices
description: Stroh 80 has been made in Klagenfurt, Austria since 1832 and built its reputation as a kitchen essential. Its power and flavour made it a key ingredient in traditional recipes like apple strudel and Sacher cake, especially for flambéing and enhancing desserts. The rum’s unique character comes from Caribbean molasses, which is imported and then blended and distilled locally. Expect rich notes of caramel, burnt sugar and spices.

name: Worthy Park 109 Rum
flavour_style: Full-bodied and funky
description: A field-to-glass Jamaican rum that has been distilled, aged, blended and bottled on the historic Worthy Park estate. Full-bodied and funky, this high-ester rum offers notes of tropical fruit, crystallised ginger and rich oak spice.

name: Pusser's Gunpowder Proof British Navy Rum
flavour_style: British Navy style rum
description: A classic British Navy style rum, Pusser's Gunpowder Proof rum has rich notes of treacle, toffee, honey and vanilla throughout the palate, alongside oak, cinnamon and ginger. Taking its name from the naval tradition of providing sailors a daily ration of rum, distributed by the Purser – or Pusser. The Pusser would dispel any complaints of watering down the rum by wetting a pinch of gunpowder with the rum and attempting to light it. If the mixture ignited it was "proof" that the rum was strong enough.

name: Hampden Estate 1753
flavour_style: funky, fruity, tropical
description: A tribute to nearly three centuries of tradition, the Hampden Estate 1753 is named after the year the estate was founded. Balanced and approachable, it’s both authentic and accessible, the perfect entry point for people new to Jamaican rum or those wanting to explore Hampden’s house style.  A pure single Jamaican rum, it’s distilled on-site using local spring water, wild-yeast fermentation, and copper pot stills, with no added sugar or artificial colouring. It carries that funky, fruity, tropical character that Hampden Estate rum has become so renowned for: think ripe banana, pineapple, tropical fruit, sugar cane, herbal notes, and a touch of petrol and spice.  Drink it neat to fully appreciate all its vibrant aromatics or mix it into cocktails for added depth and character. Whether sipping or stirring, this high-ester rum delivers boldly and leaves a lasting impression.

name: Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks
flavour_style: tropical fruit, hazelnuts, molasses, vanilla, coffee, orange zest
description: Appleton Estate’s Old Rare Casks was made by master blender Joy Spence from a blend of hand-picked pot and column still rums. Matured for at least 12 years in Jamaica, you can expect notes tropical fruit, hazelnuts and molasses, complemented by creamy vanilla, freshly ground coffee and bright orange zest.

name: Havana Club 3 Year Old Anejo Rum
flavour_style: woody caramel vanilla banana
description: This Cuban rum is aged for three years in white oak barrels, giving it a light straw colour. The nose offers woody aromas with hints of caramel, vanilla, and banana. Try this in classic cocktails like Mojitos and Daiquiris.

name: Mount Gay 25 Year Old Rum
flavour_style: rich vanilla, sweet caramel, zesty citrus, dark chocolate, tart cherry, raisins, toffee, cinnamon, toasted nuts, salt caramel, nutmeg, gingerbread
description: The world's oldest running rum distillery, Mount Gay, has launched the Exceptionally Aged Collection. Testament to generations of our Master Blenders and their skilled work, this 25 Year Old is an extremely rare chance to try a rum of such age and provenance.  Deep gold in the glass, the nose reveals rich vanilla, sweet caramel, zesty citrus, dark chocolate and an intriguing hint of tart cherry. The palate opens up further depth and complexity, with raisins and toffee balancing cinnamon and toasted nuts. A hint of salt caramel, nutmeg and gingerbread linger as the exquisitely long finish tapers off gracefully.

name: Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum 2 Glasses Gift Set
flavour_style: lip-smackingly tasty
description: A handsomely presented gift set with two Old Fashioned cocktail glasses accompanying a bottle of Venezuela's greatest export - the equally stunning and lip-smackingly tasty Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva.

name: Barcelo Imperial Maple Cask
flavour_style: caramel wild fig sandalwood sweet marasca cherry white pepper cinnamon
description: This release from Spanish rum producer Barcelo is part of its Rare Blends Collection. Its sugarcane juice rum is matured in a mix of casks, each toasted to varying levels before being finished in a maple wood cask. Imparting aromas of caramel, wild fig and sandalwood on the nose, leading to notes of sweet marasca cherry and drying to white pepper and cinnamon on the finish.

name: Santa Teresa 1796 Solera Speyside Whisky Cask Finish Rum
flavour_style: dark chocolate caramel almond and oak spice
description: This special release from Samnta Teresa uses the brand's solera process: casks of different aged rums are stacked vertically, the oldest (aged around 35 years) at the bottom, and as the distiller draws rum from one cask they top it up with younger liquid from the blend. It is then aged for up to 13 months in ex-Speyside whisky casks resulting in notes of dark chocolate, caramel, almond and oak spice.

name: El Dorado 12 Year Old
flavour_style: smoke, toffee, dark chocolate, stewed fruit, vanilla
description: This exceptional Demerara rum from El Dorado was aged for 12 years and comes inside a handsome gift box. A fantastic easy-going rum which was famously awarded the gold medal at the Caribbean Rum Taste Test for seven out of ten years. There is a subtle hint of smoke threaded through robust toffee-like flavours which lead to notes of dark chocolate, stewed fruit and hints of vanilla.

name: Hampden Estate 8 Year Old Rum
flavour_style: Intensely aromatic high-ester
description: Intensely aromatic high-ester rum with distinctive notes of tropical fruit. This pot still rum is made at Hampden Estate using the same techniques the distillery has used since the 18th century. Matured for at least eight years in Jamaica’s tropical climate, it perfectly embodies the vibrant, complex style for which Hampden is famous. Expect overripe bananas, pineapples, green coffee beans and fruity dark chocolate on the nose – the benefits of a unique, extended fermentation – along with olives, allspice, seawater, engine oil and liquorice.   Totally unique, utterly idiosyncratic and easily one of the most characterful spirits being made today, it's a very deserving winner of our Rum of the Year 2024.

name: Mount Gay 15 Year Old Rum
flavour_style: ripe banana vanilla toasted almond caramel cinnamon butterscotch orange zest plum cocoa
description: Exclusively aged in ex-American Bourbon casks, the rum is dark gold. The inviting nose is prominent with ripe banana, vanilla, toasted almond, caramel and a touch of cinnamon to lead you in. The palate is smooth and harmonious, featuring butterscotch, vanilla and caramel. Those richer elements are balanced by hints of orange zest and plum, before deeper cocoa notes round out into a nuanced, flavourful finish.

name: Brugal 1888 Doblemente Anejado Rum Double Aged
flavour_style: dried fruit and leathery sweetness
description: This special edition from Dominican producer Brugal has been double-distilled and matured in American oak before a second maturation period in sherry casks to add a dose of dried fruit and leathery sweetness to the flavours.

name: Havana Club 11 Year Old Small Batch Exclusive to The Whisky Exchange
flavour_style: orange oil, stone fruit, floral honeys, sweet spices, almond
description: This exceptional bottling was created by Havana Club’s maestro del ron Cubano Asbel Morales, exclusively for The Whisky Exchange. Never before has this historic brand produced a special expression for a single retailer, so it is with great pride that we introduce this 11-year-old rum, distilled and aged in Cuba. Bottled at cask strength – another first for Havana Club – it shows excellent texture and concentration of flavour while retaining the classic elegance we expect from light, dry Cuban rum. You can anticipate notes of orange oil and stone fruit on the nose, while the palate brings floral honeys, sweet spices and hints of almond.

name: Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum
flavour_style: orange liquorice toffee caramel vanilla fudge
description: A blend of Venezuelan rums that have been aged for up to 12 years and specially-selected by Diplomatico's master blender. The palate offers notes of orange, liquorice, toffee, caramel and vanilla fudge that linger in the finish. Try using this rum to add a sweet, creamy backbone to your favourite cocktails, or simply enjoy it over ice.

name: Goslings Black Seal 151 Rum
flavour_style: overproof dark
description: An overproof version of Goslings' iconic Black Seal rum, famous the world over for having copyrighted the Dark 'N' Stormy cocktail.  151 refers to the strength in US proof, which equates to 75.5% alcohol by volume, so please use this one responsibly - ie very sparingly - and don't drink it neat.

name: Foursquare Spiced Rum
flavour_style: spiced
description: A delicious, high-quality spiced rum from Richard Seale's Foursquare distillery on Barbados, home of Doorly's.

name: El Dorado 15 Year Old Rum
description: El Dorado 15yo is a remarkable rum, whose greatest achievement was collecting the Wray & Nephew Trophy for Best Rum in the World at the International Wine & Spirits Challenge for an unprecedented four years running.
